2607.01773.title: Verifiable Knowledge Expansion through Retrieval-Grounded Formal Concept Analysis
2607.01773.paper_summary: Ontology construction requires deciding which objects, attributes, and structural relations should be accepted as valid knowledge. Language models can propose such structures from text, but their outputs can still be unsupported or inconsistent. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented small language model (SLM) framework that uses formal concept analysis (FCA) as a symbolic verification loop for knowledge expansion. Starting from seed attributes, FCA proposes implications over a growing formal context. A retrieval-grounded SLM oracle then validates each implication or returns a counterexample. The oracle also supports incidence judgments, consistency checks, and attribute proposals, making accepted implications, counterexamples, contradictions, and corrections inspectable. In a rare ataxia setting constructed from Orphadata resources, retrieval-grounded 10-seed runs obtain relation F1 of 0.29-0.52 and closure-based implication F1 of 0.22-0.30. Larger seed sets increase the number of evaluated implications and often improve implication F1. The lower implication scores reflect a stricter evaluation of derived implications, where one missed or extra relation can affect several implication judgments. Ablations show that incidence judgments in a fixed object-attribute setting can improve closure-based implication scores. However, identifying positive object-attribute pairs remains difficult even when the candidate objects and attributes are fixed.
2607.01773.paper_summary_zh: 本體構建需要決定哪些對象、屬性和結構關係應被接受為有效知識。語言模型可以從文本中提出這些結構，但它們的輸出仍然可能不被支持或不一致。本文提出了一個檢索增強的小型語言模型（SLM）框架，該框架使用形式概念分析（FCA）作為知識擴展的符號驗證循環。從種子屬性開始，FCA 在不斷增長的形式背景上提出推論。然後，基於檢索的 SLM 神諭驗證每個推論或返回反例。該神諭還支持事件判斷、一致性檢查和屬性提議，使接受的推論、反例、矛盾和修正可供檢查。在一個從 Orphadata 資源構建的罕見共濟失調環境中，基於檢索的 10 種子運行獲得了 0.29-0.52 的關係 F1 和 0.22-0.30 的基於閉包的推論 F1。較大的種子集增加了評估推論的數量，並且通常可以改善推論 F1。較低的推論分數反映了對衍生推論的更嚴格評估，其中一個錯過或額外的關係可能會影響幾個推論判斷。消融實驗顯示，在固定的對象-屬性設置中，事件判斷可以改善基於閉包的推論分數。然而，即使候選對象和屬性是固定的，識別正面的對象-屬性對仍然很困難。
2607.01773.author: Yujin Yang et.al.
